name: 画中人 · 人物传 VOL.7（学徒版）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP8M《画中人》学徒版语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的画廊平面图、逻辑推理格（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、矛盾侦测与密码显影依赖纸面图与原文，未进题库。

m5.q: It is not easy ___ two pages at the same time.
m5.why: It 作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 to check。

m5.q: The rest of the page ___ still clean.
m5.why: the rest of 的单复数跟着 of 后面的名词走，page 是单数，用 is。
疑问词 + 不定式，整块作 told 的宾语——where to put。

m5.q: He talked about the painting as if he ___ it every morning.
m5.why: as if 引导与事实相反的情况，从句用过去式表虚拟。
宾语从句用陈述语序——主语 the drawer 在前，谓语 is 在后。

m5.q: The new page is twice ___ long as the old one.
m5.why: 倍数 + as + 原级 + as——twice as long as。

m5.q: ___ into the room, she saw that the drawer was open.
m5.why: 现在分词作状语，逻辑主语是 she，她是「进来」的发出者。

m5.q: It was Han ___ noticed the change first.
m5.why: 强调句 It was … who/that，被强调的是人 Han，且在从句里作主语。

m5.q: Someone ___ my notebook — it is not on the desk now.
m5.why: 对过去的肯定推测用 must have done——一定已经拿走了。

m5.q: When I got to the gallery, the room was empty — everyone ___ .
m5.why: 过去完成时——「走」发生在「我到」之前，两个过去时间点分先后。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: It was Chen who spoke first that afternoon.
Opening the drawer, he found nothing inside.
The rest of the paint had dried.
I wonder where did she put the key.
m5.why: wonder 后面是宾语从句，要用陈述语序 → where she put the key。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: She must have left before four.
This hall is three times as larger as that one.
He looked as if he knew the answer.
Nobody showed us how to open it.
m5.why: as…as 中间必须是原级 → three times as large as。
